entry.title: SEC notice and order approving DTC's rule change to modernize the Direct Registration System
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Depository Trust Company; Notice of Filing of Partial Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Partial Amendment No. 1, To Modernize the Direct Registration System Federal Register · Nov 23, 2026The SEC published notice of The Depository Trust Company's Partial Amendment No. 1 and approved, on an accelerated basis, the rule change as modified. The change modernizes DTC's Direct Registration System by amending the Deposits Guide and Fee Guide. Implementation is postponed until no later than June 30, 2027, with the specific date announced at least 14 days in advance. DTC said a commenter's proposed integration with DTCC Tokenization Services is outside the scope of this change. entry.title: SEC Proposes Restructuring of Consolidated Audit Trail Governance and Funding
entry.summary: SEC Issues Proposal to Restructure the Consolidated Audit Trail SEC · Nov 21, 2026 · Draft / consultationOn November 20, 2026, the SEC proposed rescinding Rule 613 of Regulation NMS and placing the Consolidated Audit Trail (CAT) under direct Commission control. entry.title: CFTC Charges 11 Companies and Two Indiana Executives in $550 Million Fraud Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Charges 11 Companies and Two Indiana Executives in $550 Million Fraud Scheme CFTC · Nov 20, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed a complaint in federal court in Indiana against two executives and 11 affiliated companies. It alleges they ran a Ponzi scheme that took more than $550 million from at least 2,100 participants, claiming the money would fund leveraged forex trading. The complaint says little to no trading occurred, with funds misappropriated or used to pay fake profits, and solicitations continued through October 2026. The court froze assets and appointed a temporary receiver, and the CFTC seeks restitution, penalties, and a permanent injunction.

entry.title: MEMX Proposes Rule Change to List Binary Options on Key Performance Indicators

entry.title: SEC approves NYSE American rule change setting a minimum market capitalization for continued listing

entry.title: IRS Advisory Council Releases Annual Public Report
entry.summary: IRS Advisory Council issues annual public report IRS · Nov 18, 2026 · ReportThe IRS Advisory Council issued its annual public report with recommendations on 33 tax administration issues, covering IRS operations, taxpayer service, compliance, tax-exempt and government entities, and information reporting. Topics include IRS resources for revenue collection, reducing compliance friction, ghost preparers, identity theft resolution, Form W-4 simplification, penalty abatement, artificial intelligence use by preparers, and worker classification.

entry.title: Treasury and IRS issue final rules expanding automatic enrollment in workplace retirement plans
entry.summary: Treasury, IRS issue final rules to help hardworking Americans build a financially secure retirement IRS · Nov 17, 2026 · RuleThe Treasury and IRS issued final regulations implementing a key SECURE 2.0 Act provision on automatic enrollment in certain 401(k) and 403(b) plans. The rules give employers clearer guidance while employees keep control over their contribution levels, and they simplify certain participant notices. The regulations generally apply to plan years beginning after December 31, 2027.

entry.title: CFTC Releases Agenda for December Roundtable on 24/7 Derivatives Trading
entry.summary: CFTC Announces Agenda for December Roundtable on 24/7 Trading CFTC · Nov 17, 2026 · MeetingThe U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission released the agenda for an industry roundtable on whether derivatives markets can move to 24/7 trading. entry.title: CFTC sues Louisiana over state court order shutting down CFTC-regulated exchanges
entry.summary: CFTC Sues Louisiana After State Court Blocks CFTC-Regulated Exchanges CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission sued Louisiana to block the state from banning event contracts offered by CFTC-regulated exchanges, clearing organizations and futures commission merchants. A state court had ordered more than 30 companies in the state to stop operating without notice or a chance to be heard. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said event contracts have traded openly in Louisiana for years and that the suit seeks to preserve the status quo while federal courts decide the issue.

entry.title: IRS names 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee
entry.summary: IRS appoints 10 new members to Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee IRS · Nov 13, 2026 · PersonnelThe IRS announced the appointment of 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee (ETAAC). Established by statute in 1998, the committee is a public forum for discussing electronic tax administration issues. Its members include state tax officials, cybersecurity experts, tax professionals, software developers, and representatives from payroll, financial, and consumer groups.

entry.title: IRS fiscal 2026 results: record tax collections, faster refunds and expanded digital services
entry.summary: IRS achieved historic performance in 2026 for American taxpayers, efficiently delivering new tax benefits to working families IRS · Oct 29, 2026 · ReportThe IRS announced its fiscal year 2026 results, reporting record tax collections of $5.6 trillion, up nearly 5 percent from the previous year. Total refunds and average refunds both increased, with about 90 percent of electronic filers receiving refunds in less than 21 days. The release also covers growth in digital service use, about $38 billion in revenue protected from identity theft refund fraud, and progress on Trump Accounts for children. Correction Nov 14, 2026: Publication date changed from Oct 30, 2026 to Oct 29, 2026

entry.title: CFTC sues Arkansas to defend federal jurisdiction over prediction markets
entry.summary: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets CFTC · Nov 13, 2026 · EnforcementOn November 13, 2026, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announced a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state's effort to halt event-contract trading and impose civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. The CFTC says Arkansas's civil enforcement action against Kalshi in state court is preempted by federal law. Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agency will keep defending its sole jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued.

entry.title: SEC proposes reforms to executive and director pay disclosure rules

Public comments are accepted for 60 days after Federal Register publication. The archived text and attachments run to about 1,207,539 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000.
